scenarios.name: Open temporary ribbon commands using a tab key tip

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the top-docked ribbon is minimized to tabs with 3D Model active
key tips appear on the ribbon tabs and quick-access controls
the 3D Model tab displays the key tip "M"
the temporary 3D Model command area opens
the temporary 3D Model command area remains visible
the user clicks empty viewport space
the temporary command area closes and the ribbon remains minimized to tabs
the user double-clicks the 3D Model tab
the full 3D Model ribbon is visible
